title: ML↔MLOPS-001: Model Artifact & Drift Metric Definitions + Pipeline/Registry Services
description: The Edge AI/ML Engineer provides reproducible training and conversion code, the model artifact and metadata, and the drift-monitoring metric definitions; the MLOps Engineer provides the CI/CD (Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery) training/conversion pipeline, the model registry, automated quantization/packaging, implemented drift monitoring, and fleet telemetry for analysis. Grounded in EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4 and MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.1. Drift monitoring is erosion-shaped detection evaluated against FC-022 (closed-loop silent corruption); model signing / supply-chain integrity stay under MLOPS↔SEC-001, and OTA packaging/dispatch under FW↔MLOPS-001 / MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001.

model_handoff.description: ML→MLOPS: reproducible code, model artifact + metadata, drift-metric definitions, acceptance thresholds.

drift_metric_definitions.description: Erosion-shaped drift metrics (FC-022); each carries a threshold with an explicit unit.

mlops_pipeline_services.description: MLOPS→ML: CI pipeline, registry, quantization/packaging, drift monitoring, fleet telemetry.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Model registration, reproducibility, and drift-metric definition cross the model/pipeline boundary and are ratified by humans (pipeline alignment at planning; artifact handoff/registration at production-ready). Drift design maps to FC-022; a registry-schema or pipeline change exceeding the precedented surface coordinates via RES↔MLOPS-001 / ADR.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (pipeline alignment at planning; artifact handoff and registration during development and production-ready; ongoing drift-review cycles)
confirm_conditions: reproducible training and conversion code references accompany the model artifact + metadata (model_id + version)
every drift metric and acceptance threshold carries an explicit unit
the pipeline/registry services and quantization/packaging mode are stated
drift monitoring is confirmed implementable against available fleet telemetry (FC-022)
reject_conditions: a drift metric, threshold, or acceptance value emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a model registered without reproducible training/conversion code (reproducibility requirement)
drift monitoring claimed implemented when current fleet telemetry cannot support the metric (Honesty Over Polish §10.3; FC-022 blind spot)
counter_conditions: a drift metric is not computable from available fleet telemetry — request a telemetry-feasible erosion-shaped metric (FC-022)
a novel artifact format/registry-schema change is implied — route it through RES↔MLOPS-001 / an ADR before registration
